| `UDreamWidget* AddWidgetOfClassToViewport(UObject* WorldContextObject, TSubclassOf<UDreamUserWidget> InWidgetClass, int32 SortOrder)` | callable | UMG-style CreateWidget + AddToViewport convenience node for a DreamUI prefab. Return pin follows InWidgetClass. |
| `bool AttachWidgetToSceneComponent(UDreamWidget* InRoot, USceneComponent* InSceneComponent)` | callable | Put a root widget made with ConstructWidget into the world: the counterpart of AddToViewport for world-space UI, and what a prefab presenter does for the tree it loads. The root must carry a DreamCanvas (the canvas decides the render mode and owns the meshes); it is attached to InSceneComponent, which gives it its world transform, and leaves the not-yet-added state. Returns false, and changes nothing, when InRoot has a parent or no canvas. |
| `UDreamWidget* ConstructWidget(UObject* WorldContextObject, FString DisplayName, TSubclassOf<UDreamVisual> VisualClass)` | callable | Make a widget that exists but is not on screen -- the counterpart of UMG's WidgetTree::ConstructWidget<T>(). It draws nothing and its behaviours do not run until you hand it to AddChild or AddToViewport; until then it is held by the DreamUI manager, so it will not be collected out from under you while you configure it. |
| `UDreamWidget* CreateDreamWidgetOfClass(UObject* WorldContextObject, TSubclassOf<UDreamUserWidget> InWidgetClass)` | callable | Instantiate a prefab without putting it anywhere -- the counterpart of UMG's CreateWidget(WidgetBlueprintClass). Same not-on-screen state as ConstructWidget, including a prefab whose root carries its own UDreamCanvas, which would otherwise start rendering the moment it existed. |
